instructions.name: ping
docs: Placeholder instruction so the scaffold builds, deploys and has a smoke test.

instructions.name: set_demo_mode
docs: Only in builds with the `devnet` feature, which is on by default; a mainnet build turns
it off with `--no-default-features` (D21, D52).

accounts.name: close_record
docs: `["close", slot relay signer, ticker, trading_day (u32 LE)]`; for a Pyth slot, the first
receiver price update. Validated in the handler, because it is legitimately uninitialized
when the ticker-day is final from an admin price.

types.name: AdminPriceMismatch
docs: An oracle price settled a ticker-day that had a different admin price pending.

fields.name: trading_day
docs: YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: trading_day
docs: YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: strike
docs: `strike × 10^strike_expo` is the strike price.

fields.name: collateral
docs: USDC base units backing outstanding pairs. Never read from the vault balance.

fields.name: pairs_outstanding
docs: Whole Yes/No pairs outstanding (each backed by `UNIT` USDC base units).

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Zeroed space for the settlement package (pending admin price and time, and the like), so
its fields fit in markets created before that upgrade.

types.name: OpenOrders
docs: A trader's seat inside the book. A seat with `owner == Pubkey::default()` is free. Locked
amounts are derived from the owner's resting orders.

fields.name: free_yes
docs: Yes base units the owner can withdraw with `settle_funds`.

fields.name: free_usdc
docs: USDC base units the owner can withdraw with `settle_funds`.

fields.name: relay_signer
docs: `MeridianRelay`: the relay signer for this slot.

fields.name: feed_ids
docs: `Pyth` feed IDs or `ChainlinkDataStreams` stream IDs, in `Config.tickers` order.

fields.name: verifier_program
docs: `ChainlinkDataStreams`: the verifier program.

fields.name: min_verification_level
docs: `Pyth`: the minimum verification level.

types.name: Order
docs: A resting order. A slot with `qty == 0` is empty.

fields.name: qty
docs: Remaining whole tokens.

fields.name: price
docs: Cents.

fields.name: seat
docs: Index into `OrderBook::seats`.

types.name: OrderBook
docs: Order book for one market. The order-book fields follow the header; `market` stays first.
Order and seat types live in `state/orderbook.rs`.

types.name: OrderFilled
docs: One per fill, emitted with `emit_cpi!`. Names both sides because the maker's fill happens in
the taker's transaction.

fields.name: price
docs: Cents: the maker's price.

fields.name: qty
docs: Whole tokens.

fields.name: n
docs: Whole pairs.

fields.name: n
docs: Whole pairs.

fields.name: payout
docs: USDC base units paid.

types.name: TickerDay
docs: One settlement price for every strike of a ticker and trading day.

fields.name: trading_day
docs: YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: pending_admin_at
docs: 0 when no admin price is pending.

fields.name: settle_numerator
docs: The exact final price, `settle_numerator / settle_denominator × 10^settle_expo`. An
interpolated close is a fraction, and every strike compares against it rather than the
rounded `settle_price`. The denominator is 0 until the ticker-day is final.

types.name: UpdateConfigArgs
docs: `None` leaves a field unchanged.
